property_summary: For any non-empty tos and vs arrays and a compliant callee, C always calls the callee's transferFrom for every index starting at 0 (so the first recipient at index 0 is always invoked); the mutant starts its loop at 1 and thus may skip invoking index 0, violating this rule.
change_summary: Change the loop to skip the first transfer (start index from 1), so fewer calls are made and state changes from those skipped calls are absent.
